resources.string: When earlier scenes in this context lack summaries

If recent summaries are incomplete, send only the manual summary when available. Otherwise:
• Wait: wait for queued or running earlier tasks; ask for action if none exist.
• Do not wait: report missing summaries immediately.
• Send source text: include all earlier scenes without summaries, in full. Later scenes are excluded.
Missing source text or an exceeded context limit requires action.
Send full source text without summaries
Maximum output tokens for translation and repair, separate from input context length. Stay within the model and provider limit to avoid rejected requests.
When enabled, repair and write back chunks as they arrive; otherwise, repair and write back the full response. Applies to newly started tasks; resumed tasks keep their original chunking policy.

For debug comparisons; on by default. Omits reasoning_effort, thinking budgets and the thinking beta header from translation, repair and summary requests. Provider defaults apply; thinking may still be enabled. Keeps your selected strength and streaming mode. Applies to newly started tasks.
Log API request and response bodies

Off by default. Saves translation and repair request bodies and raw responses to daily internal logs and logcat, including thinking and translated text. Logs can be large. Headers are excluded and API keys redacted. Applies to newly started tasks.

Create translation tasks from PageRec scenes

Requires PageRec export. Exported scenes use normal saving, translation and game write-back. Scenes with official target-language translations are skipped. Complete translations are written back directly; existing scenes keep saved content. New translations are written back when complete; streaming chunks follow existing write-back settings. Parse-only mode still blocks translation requests. May create tasks for multiple loaded scenes. Restart the game to apply.

Keeps the game connected and exports complete scenes. Uses Simplified Chinese, then Traditional Chinese, then Japanese. Files go to the game’s private files/housamo_embed_trans/page_rec directory. Exports are excluded from sync, translation and write-back unless added as tasks below. Restart the game after enabling or disabling.

Sync scenes for new translation tasks
Automatically sync scenes after accepting a new translation task. When disabled, a result may wait for manual sync or game reconnection before it can be saved to HET. Existing results are retained.
